program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (20.0, 16.0, 24.0),           # pair gm/Id [S/A]
    "L_in":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),              # pair length [um]
    "Id_pair": (30e-6, 15e-6, 32e-6),        # per-branch current; tail = 2*Id_pair
    "C":       (0.4e-12, 0.2e-12, 0.6e-12),  # Sallen-Key C1 [F]; larger C shrinks relative parasitic error
    "gmid_p":  (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),            # PMOS mirror load gm/Id [S/A]
    "gmid_t":  (20.0, 12.0, 22.0),           # reference/tail mirror gm/Id (L = 1 um)
    "fc_t":    (2.2e6, 1.3e6, 2.6e6),        # Sallen-Key design target [Hz]; widened so refinement can reach fc
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-12)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 1.0)               # DC level of the buffer (vin = vout)
    Id = p["Id_pair"]
    C = p["C"]
    fc_t = p["fc_t"]

    # Tail node estimate, then re-size the pair with body effect
    m1a = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Id, vds=0.85, vsb=0.0)
    v_tail = vcm - m1a.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Id, vds=0.85, vsb=v_tail)

    # Reference and tail mirror, same L and gm/Id
    ref = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], 1.0, iref, vds=0.7)
    tail = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], 1.0, 2 * Id, vds=v_tail)

    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], 1.0, Id, vds=0.6)

    # Sallen-Key unity-gain lowpass, C2 = C + cgg of the pair gate
    C2e = C + m1.cgg
    R = 1.0 / (2 * PI * fc_t * math.sqrt(C * C2e))
    Q = 0.5 * math.sqrt(C / C2e)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", ref)
    n.dev("Mt", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", tail)
    # Pair: gate b is non-inverting, gate vout is the feedback gate
    n.dev("M1", "left", "b", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vout", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "left", "left", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "left", "vdd", "vdd", m3)

    n.R("R1", "vin", "a", R)
    n.R("R2", "a", "b", R)
    n.C("C1", "a", "vout", C)
    n.C("C2", "b", "vss", C)

    x = 10.0
    mag_stop = 1.0 / math.sqrt((1 - x * x) ** 2 + (x / Q) ** 2)
    atten = -db(mag_stop)
    if Q > 1.0 / math.sqrt(2.0):
        peak = db(Q / math.sqrt(1.0 - 1.0 / (4.0 * Q * Q)))
    else:
        peak = 0.0
    i_total = iref + 2 * Id
    pred = {
        "gain_db": db(1.0),
        "fc": fc_t,
        "atten_db": atten,
        "peaking_db": peak,
        "f0": fc_t,
        "q": Q,
        "power": 1.8 * i_total,
    }
    return n, pred
